verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents programmatic APIs: a CKS API, an Inference API with Connect/gRPC/Protobuf clients, and a changelog of release notes. None of the evidence mentions API versioning schemes or a deprecation policy. Having APIs and a changelog is adjacent to this story and does not show that the product delivers versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
